papers.title: ELEMENT LOSS OF AZ91D MAGNESIUM ALLOY DURING SELECTIVE LASER MELTING PROCESS
papers.abstract: Magnesium alloys have attracted more attentions due to their low densities and excellent specific strengths. However, proper manufacturing methods are still needed to promote further applications of magnesium alloys due to the shortcomings of conventional processing methods. As one of the most promising additive manufacturing technologies, selective laser melting (SLM) was utilized to process the most commonlyused AZ91D magnesium alloy in this work. Element vaporization mechanism during the forming process and the influence of element vaporization on chemical composition, microstructure, and mechanical properties of the final products were investigated using OM, SEM, EDS, XRF and XRD. llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了AZ91D镁合金在SLM过程中的元素损失，未涉及生物医学植入物的应力遮挡、多孔结构或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue, or surface roughness relevant to biomedical implants; it focuses on elemental composition changes during SLM processing.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究镁合金SLM过程中的元素损失机制及其对性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制备AZ91D镁合金，通过OM、SEM、EDS等手段分析元素损失
summary_zh.result: SLM样品中Mg含量下降，Al和Zn相对含量增加，致密度达98%以上
summary_zh.validation: 通过微观组织和力学性能测试验证工艺参数影响

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates the vaporization mechanism of elements during selective laser melting of AZ91D magnesium alloy and its influence on final product properties.
summary_en.method: AZ91D magnesium alloy was processed by selective laser melting, and the chemical composition, microstructure, and mechanical properties were characterized using OM, SEM, EDS, XRF, and XRD.
summary_en.result: The relative Mg content in SLM-processed samples decreased from 90.63% to 86.61-88.68%, while Al and Zn content increased correspondingly.
summary_en.validation: Experimental characterization confirmed the correlation between element loss and process parameters, with high density achieved.
